headline: Breaking! IHSG Soars 1%, Here's the Cause
summary: The Indonesian stock index turned higher in the first session, reaching 5,206.43. CNBC Indonesia said the market faces important sentiment this week.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index tracks the broad Indonesian stock market, so its moves reflect local investor sentiment and foreign flows.
